purpose: Separate ability to use YouTube, publish videos, unlock product features, and receive money. No personal account credentials or identity data are required for this public ontology.

objects.label: Google Account
objects.definition: Signed-in account that can watch, like and subscribe without operating a publishing channel

objects.label: Personal YouTube channel
objects.definition: Publishing identity ordinarily managed by the account holder

objects.label: Brand Account channel
objects.definition: Channel using a business or alternative name that can have multiple owners or managers

objects.label: YouTube Studio feature eligibility
objects.definition: Current access to standard, intermediate, and advanced features, dependent on verification and policy record

objects.label: Published video
objects.definition: Uploaded and made visible according to the selected publication setting; not the same event as uploading a file

objects.label: Approved earning creator
objects.definition: A creator meeting independent YPP or external earning gates; uploading and verifying a channel never guarantee this status

stages.label: Use a Google Account
stages.outcome: Viewing, liking and subscribing where available
stages.limits: Account age and supervised-experience rules may restrict features

stages.label: Create a publishing channel
stages.entry: Create a personal channel or Brand Account-linked channel
stages.outcome: YouTube publishing identity with name and handle
stages.limits: Supervised accounts may be unable to create a channel

stages.label: Use standard publishing features
stages.entry: Eligible channel without active Community Guidelines strikes
stages.outcome: Standard uploads and Shorts, with limited daily quotas
stages.limits: Uploads are subject to policy, moderation, and service quotas; uploaded is not necessarily publicly published

stages.label: Unlock intermediate features
stages.entry: Verify a phone number through YouTube Studio
stages.outcome: Additional features such as longer videos, custom thumbnails and computer live streaming, subject to separate product conditions
stages.limits: Phone or SMS delivery may not be supported by all carriers; mobile live has separate restrictions

stages.label: Unlock advanced features
stages.entry: After phone verification, establish sufficient channel history OR, where offered, complete ID or video verification
stages.outcome: Examples include pinned comments and higher daily limits
stages.limits: Not all creators can use ID/video verification; history standard is conditional and access can be lost

stages.label: Apply separately for monetization
stages.entry: Meet the appropriate YPP tier, jurisdiction and product-policy gates, then pass review and set up payment
stages.outcome: Potential eligibility for specified earning modules if approved
stages.limits: Standard channel, phone and advanced feature states do not by themselves grant payouts; no representative time-to-first-earnings known

feature_gates.label: Standard
feature_gates.limits: Availability varies with account and separate product policies

feature_gates.label: Intermediate
feature_gates.limits: No account-specific eligibility can be inferred from this general checklist

feature_gates.label: Advanced
feature_gates.limits: ID/video verification is optional alternative, not offered to all creators; primary owner alone can perform this method

feature_gates.label: Monetization
feature_gates.limits: Products and geographic conditions differ; published content alone is not monetization

entry_pathway.action: Create a personal or Brand channel using an existing eligible Google Account
Produce a lawful video using already-owned tools and appropriately licensed media
Upload to YouTube Studio; choose accurate audience, rights and visibility information
Publish or schedule if available, distinguishing private/unlisted content from public access
Evaluate public results without claiming earned payouts, audience uniqueness or zero production effort

accounting.no_cost_justification: A creator may already have equipment and network access; platform publishing access must not be equated with economic zero cost.

privacy_safeguards: Research must not ask a person to upload identity documents, phone verification codes, or account credentials.
This public source-backed pathway is informational and not personalized proof of eligibility.
A Brand Account manager is not necessarily the primary owner authorized to perform advanced identity verification.
Optional identity and video verification should not be presented as mandatory when channel history is accepted.
